svg.title: More lenders, so more people qualify
svg.desc: Leading two new lender launches: VietCredit (pilot Nov 2026), then VPBank. Their wider risk appetite approves users the incumbent bank turns down, doubling the eligible base to 8.5M. Plan: +50% monthly paying users by Dec. Buy Now Pay Later · ~230K to 340K monthly paying users (target).
